prompt: 打开 https://compass.jinritemai.com 如果需要登录就停下来
notes: Phase 3 R1 — duplicates P0_006 to validate the state-machine guard fix on a domain we already know triggers a login URL. mustContainAny is more permissive than P0_006 to make the test stable across model phrasings of the synthesised park question.

prompt: 打开 https://www.zhihu.com/signin 如果需要登录就停下来
notes: Direct nav to zhihu's login page. URL path /signin matches LOGIN_URL_PATH_NEEDLES; the deterministic detector fires regardless of LLM phrasing. Validates the detector is robust across hosts (jinritemai is /login, zhihu is /signin).

prompt: 打开 https://httpbin.org/anything/captcha 看看上面写了什么
notes: URL path /captcha matches CAPTCHA_URL_PATH_NEEDLES. httpbin.org/anything echoes back arbitrary URLs as JSON, so the actual response isn't a real captcha page — but the detector fires on URL alone before content is interpreted. Validates the path-based detector + the captcha-specific park question (mentions '已验证' rather than '已登录').

prompt: 打开 https://httpbin.org/status/403 看看返回了什么
notes: httpbin.org/status/403 returns HTTP 403 explicitly. URL path /403 matches PERMISSION_URL_PATH_NEEDLES (handles the path-only signal); the kind-specific park message says '需要账号权限或会员权限' / '继续' (distinct from login's '已登录'). Validates the permission-wall detection + distinct kind copy.

prompt: 打开 https://example.com 告诉我页面标题
notes: Sanity check that the per-user Brave pool isn't wedged after the four prior parking cases (P3_AUTH_001..004). If the watchdog + state-guard work, the parked tasks released their per-task Brave on terminal/timeout and this case starts cleanly. Same shape as P0_004 but runs AFTER the parking suite — implicit pool-recovery test. If this case fails with PoolCapacityError or similar, the watchdog isn't releasing properly.

prompt: 打开 https://www.xiaohongshu.com 帮我看下首页内容
notes: Phase 3 R2 — xiaohongshu.com homepage is gated even though the URL has no /login path. The site config's loginBodyPhrases (扫码登录小红书 / 登录解锁更多内容) catches the login form via body-text fallback. Also exercises the auto popup-dismiss (cookie banner if present).
